fullPassage: For some organisations, filing in triplicate — a widely used system of classification that creates three copies of each document to distribute and store in different places — may be unavoidable. For most of us, such a system is a huge waste of time, space, and energy. If you need to file physical documents, what about the following beautiful alternative, invented by Japanese economist Yukio Noguchi? Forget about categories. Instead, place each incoming document in a large envelope. Write the envelope's contents neatly on its edge and line them up on a bookshelf, their contents visible like the spines of books. Now the moment of genius: every time you use an envelope, place it back on the left of the shelf. Over time, recently used documents will shuffle themselves towards the left and never-used documents will accumulate on the right. Archiving is easy: every now and again, you remove the documents on the right. To find any document, simply ask yourself how recently you've seen it. It is a filing system that all but organises itself, and it has won many fans.

questions.passage: For some organisations, filing in triplicate — a widely used system of classification that creates three copies of each document to distribute and store in different places — may be unavoidable. For most of us, such a system is a huge waste of time, space, and energy. If you need to file physical documents, what about the following beautiful alternative, invented by Japanese economist Yukio Noguchi? Forget about categories. Instead, place each incoming document in a large envelope. Write the envelope's contents neatly on its edge and line them up on a bookshelf, their contents visible like the spines of books. Now the moment of genius: every time you use an envelope, place it back on the left of the shelf. Over time, recently used documents will shuffle themselves towards the left and never-used documents will accumulate on the right. Archiving is easy: every now and again, you remove the documents on the right. To find any document, simply ask yourself how recently you've seen it. It is a filing system that __________, and it has won many fans.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
① creates three copies: 세 부 만든다 — 삼중복사 시스템 설명
② is widely used: 널리 쓰인다 — Noguchi 시스템 특성 아님
③ requires careful planning: 신중한 계획 필요 — 간편함이 핵심이므로 모순
④ all but organises itself: 거의 스스로 정리된다 — 원문 일치 ←정답
det.tip: all but=거의, 사실상. organise itself=스스로 정리하다
